base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: This is a list of all checks specific to the CX800 Pilot. It is not possible to create a certificate.

product:Description.base:Title: Reagent Transfer Head Pipetting

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: Reagent transfer head pipetting checks

product:Description.base:Title: Reagent transfer head pipetting intro PM A

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: Checks the pipetting accuracy of the reagent transfer head using the onboard weighing system.
Preconditions:
- The instrument is in interlock service mode
- The front cover of the processing module is open
- The load reagent command was executed
Required Time: 5 min
Required Equipment:
- Tool onboard weighing system (OWS)
- Tool holder for onboard weighing system
Required bulk reagent and waste volumes (will be checked automatically and can be loaded during execution):
- 154 ml wash reagent in the wash reagent reservoir, else 910 ml in wash reagent container to fill the wash reagent reservoir
- 208 ml specimen diluent
- 612 ml liquid waste capacity (300 ml tolerance included)

product:Description.base:Title: Reagent transfer head OWS calibration PM A

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: Calibrates the balance.
Preconditions:
- The instrument is in interlock service mode
- Processing module front cover is opened
- Reagent transfer head pipetting intro was executed
- It is recommended to have the balance powered on for 30 minutes before executing the check
Required Time: 5 minutes
Required Equipment:
- The balance
- 1 Mettler Toledo pair of tweezers
- 1 Mettler Toledo calibration standard weight (10g)
- Weighing boat
- Draft shield for weighing boat
Required consumables/reagents: None

product:Description.base:Title: Volume-dependent reagent transfer head channel A calibration PM A

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: It calibrates the microgear pump of the selected reagent transfer head channels
Preconditions:
- The reagent transfer head pipetting intro and balance calibration check should have been performed
- Make sure the correct weighing boat (06677908001) has been placed
Required Time: 8 minutes
Required bulk reagent and waste volumes (will be checked automatically and can be loaded during execution):
- 130 ml wash reagent in the wash reagent reservoir, else 910 ml in wash reagent container to fill the wash reagent reservoir
- 44 ml specimen diluent
- 430 ml liquid waste capacity
Caution: Reagent transfer head moves during calibration!

product:Description.base:Title: Load reagents PM A

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: It verifies that the processing module A fluidics can be loaded with reagents.
Preconditions: None
Required Time: 7 minutes
Required Equipment:
- 2 specimen diluent containers
- 2 lysis reagent containers
- 3 wash reagent containers
- In case of enabled on-system liquid waste handling, 3 liquid waste containers

product:Description.base:Title: Flush check PM A

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: This check flushes the instrument.
Preconditions:
- The instrument is in interlock service mode
- Processing module front cover is open
- Overflow bottle is empty
- Load reagents command is executed with the required equipment
Required Time: 15-20 min
Required Equipment:
- 2 tip racks
- Empty bottle kit
- 3 wash reagent containers filled with deionized water
- 2 specimen diluent bottles filled with deionized water
- 2 lysis reagent bottles filled with deionized water
- In case of enabled on-system liquid waste handling: 3 empty liquid waste containers

product:Description.base:Title: Dry check PM A

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: This check dries the instrument.
Preconditions:
- The instrument is in interlock service mode
- Processing module front cover is open
- Overflow bottle is empty
- Load reagents command is executed with the required equipment
(wash reagent containers, specimen diluent bottles and lysis bottles are removed)
Required Time: 20 min
Required Equipment:
- 2 tip racks
- In case of enabled on-system liquid waste handling: 3 empty liquid waste containers

product:Description.base:Title: Wash reagent reservoir and degassing check PM A

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: This check teaches and verifies the correct functioning of the wash reagent reservoir and the degassing pump.
Precondition: Overflow bottle is empty
Required Time: 20 min
Required Equipment:
- 2700 ml wash reagent in a wash reagent container with valid RFID.
- In case of enabled on-system liquid waste handling, 3615 ml liquid waste capacity (300 ml tolerance included) with valid RFID.

product:Description.base:Title: Flush maintenance check PM A

base:Paragraphs.base:Paragraph: Service function to flush the liquid waste tubing in the processing module A.
Preconditions: Liquid waste stations must be empty.
Required Time: 15 minutes
Required Equipment:
- 1 full wash reagent container with RFID, which is readable and matches the supported type
- 3 empty liquid waste containers
- 3-5% NaOH solution (approx. 140 ml per liquid waste station)
- 2 Waste inserts
Warning!
Please read your country specific MSDS (available on PIM.web) before use.
Direct contact with cleaning solutions might cause skin irritation, inflammation, or burns. Refer to about reagents and working solutions.

Precondition: None
Required Time: 5 minutes
Required Equipment: 1 diluent bottle with valid RFID (filled with diluent reagent)
liquid waste containers:
* in case of enabled on-system liquid waste handling: 3 liquid waste containers (empty)
* in case of enabled off-system liquid waste handling: 2 liquid waste containers (empty)

liquid waste containers:

* in case of enabled off-system liquid waste handling: 2 liquid waste containers (empty)

liquid waste containers:

- 2 tip racks

- In case of enabled on-system liquid waste handling: 3 empty liquid waste containers
